external_state.classical_anchor: state abstraction and bisimulation (Li et al. 2006; Abel 2020): the coarsest partition that preserves the dynamics -- realised here as the strongest relation every repeat satisfies
external_state.refused_instrument: AGENTSCOPE (arXiv 2609.02371) verifies abstractions against neural invariants; a model is not a verifier, so every verdict here is a subprocess exit code and a byte comparison
external_state.the_two_gaps_are_one_operation: arXiv 2607.09560 (Beyond Fixed Representations): the vocabulary gap is inventing and stabilising new primitives, the verifier gap is judging whether one is worth keeping; representation expands only when the previously untestable becomes testable
external_state.when_to_refine_an_abstraction: arXiv 2606.06123 (adaptive abstractions via rate-distortion): refine when the error inside the abstraction reaches the error induced by it -- a refusal is that condition at its extreme

unrepresentable_action_mkdir.growth: the observation enumerates regular files; a dire

what_this_shows: 5 real actions, each failing for a different reason, and the failure itself decides which vocabulary is missing: 5/5 diagnoses match what actually happened, and the growth carries to a held-out action of the same kind 5/5 times. The three growable cases are bought, not declared -- a derived predicate that stops an action being silently accepted as doing nothing, a set-valued consequence that makes an unpredictable action's one load-bearing property testable, and one composition that the flat grammar cannot express. The 1 non-growable case is the boundary that matters: `unrepresentable_action_mkdir` has a real effect on disk and every view in the family is empty, so no predicate built from the same readings can ever reach it -- that is a missing sensor, not a missing word, and no amount of experience closes it. Nothing is trained: a primitive is kept only when it is necessary, stable, transferable and narrow, which is the verifier gap closed by construction instead of declared.
